home.heroEyebrow: Bab Al-Balad · Authenticity at one table
home.storyTitle: From the heart of heritage to your table
home.storyBody: Our journey began with a passion for authentic flavors and a deep commitment to hospitality. Today, we serve a dining experience that blends the warmth of home with the heritage of oriental cuisine, in an atmosphere designed to remind you of the unforgettable taste of detail. Every dish has a story, every guest has a place at our table.
home.branchesSubtitle: Visit us at any of our branches and discover atmospheres crafted for every moment.
home.appTitle: The Bab Al-Balad experience, now in your hands
home.appBody: Discover authentic flavors, earn rewards, and order effortlessly from your phone. Everything you need in one app.
home.menuSubtitle: Browse our daily dishes, main courses, and authentic oriental desserts.
home.eventsBody: We provide hospitality services for events and corporate functions, with details that match the scale and style of your occasion. From event bookings to external catering, our team handles every detail.
home.ctaDescription: Reserve your table now and our team will reach out to confirm
